recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If future build tooling starts consuming the Distance Restrictions sheet for Count, reconcile that sheet separately after confirming its build role; no current FHIR-core source fix is needed for FHIR-16954.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-I change request to fix Count cnt-3 because the old text said Count had to be an expression of length, which is inappropriate for a count.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn 14287. Git commit 495348bc65a433ebf3c01152732f2b401170331b (GF#16954 - fix Count constraint) maps to that application and removed the length phrase from source/datatypes/count.xml. source/fhir.ini lists Count as an active datatype, and current source/datatypes/count.xml has the corrected cnt-3 human text.
additional_context: The current build Count profile also shows the corrected wording. A legacy duplicate Count row remains in the Restrictions sheet of source/datatypes/distance.xml with the old length phrase, but that row is outside the active Count datatype source and does not surface in the current built Count profile; it also lacks later Count invariant updates, reinforcing that it is not the authoritative Count constraint source. Jira phrase searches found no related Jira beyond FHIR-16954, and quoted Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community or work-group evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the current Count source and conformance surface already implement the issue, and changing the stale Distance Restrictions copy would not correct the current Count specification.
